title: PendingPublishSummary
description: A repo-safe, read-only **row-level** read-model for a 'pending publish' summary: the set of individual proposed items (action items, decisions, attendance records, obligations, allocations, settlements, evidence notes, risk notes) that an organizer reviews — one row at a time — before any documented next step. This contract is the **composed body** of `preview-review.preview_kind = "pending_publish_summary"`; it does **not** replace `urn:icn:contract:preview-review:v1`. The wrapper contract (`urn:icn:contract:preview-review:v1`) defines the human **review boundary** (one preview, one review status, one privacy posture); this contract defines the **pending-publish rows that back a `pending_publish_summary` preview**. The producing system uses this contract to populate and summarize those rows; the two are sibling packets linked by role/URN, not nested (the wrapper schema is additionalProperties:false and defines no field for an embedded body). The schema is read-only: it does not mutate, publish, apply, or export anything. Each row's `review_actions` are affordances the organizer *could* take (approve / reject / edit / request more info); rendering them performs nothing. Each row's `mutation_preview` *describes* what a separate, named, documented endpoint would create later if the row were approved — it carries no executable payload. `source_provenance_ref` is a category plus a safe reference label, never a private path. `receipt_expected` describes the expected receipt/evidence *category*, never live receipt data. Human-readable labels (roles, bodies, scopes) are permitted; DIDs are never required. Partner-internal data does not enter this contract; partner repositories define their own opt-in fields out-of-band. The schema $id is a non-DNS URN so contract identity does not depend on centralized DNS or registrar infrastructure; see docs/contracts/pending-publish-summary.md for the rationale and the architectural principle in docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE_DUE_DILIGENCE.md.
x-icn-composition-note: Row-level body for preview-review.preview_kind = 'pending_publish_summary'. This contract does not replace preview-review; the producing system uses it to populate and summarize a pending_publish_summary preview. The two are sibling packets linked by role/URN, not nested (the wrapper schema is additionalProperties:false and carries no field for an embedded body).
x-icn-must-not-include: real personal names (unless explicitly fictional / example-only)
accommodation or access needs tied to an identifiable person
API tokens, secrets, signed URLs, or session credentials
private Drive / Groups / Sheets paths or content
any field that implies production deployment or formal pilot authorization
free-form mutation payloads (this is a read-model contract; mutation is performed by separate documented endpoints)

schema_version.description: Semver-style version of this schema the packet was authored against. Accepts 'MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH' or 'MAJOR.MINOR'. Bumped only when the schema's required fields or closed enums change.

contract_id.description: The non-DNS URN identifying this contract. Pin to the URN, not to a file path or DNS URL.

generated_at.description: RFC 3339 'date-time' (e.g. 2026-06-09T00:00:00Z). Wall-clock moment the pending-publish summary was finalized for review.

source_package.description: Generic, package-agnostic description of the producing system. Categories and labels only — never a partner noun, private path, or live operational detail.

label.description: Generic human-readable label for the producing package (e.g. 'Example institution package'). Never a real partner name.

category.description: Closed taxonomy of generic producer categories. 'institution_package' = a package that adapts an institution's local material into ICN shapes. 'fixture_pack' = a committed fixture bundle. 'meeting_notes_parser' = a parser that lifts proposals from meeting notes. 'governance_export' = an export of staged governance state. 'other' = any other generic producer.

source_material.description: Inputs the rows were derived from. Each entry is described by safe basename and category — never by raw external path. 'committed-fixture' = file already in the repository. 'example-snippet' = inline fictional content authored for the preview. 'repo-safe-paste' = content reviewed and confirmed to contain no private fields before being pasted into the preview surface. 'sha256' is optional and only meaningful for committed fixtures or otherwise public content.

basename.description: File or snippet basename only — no directory paths, no Drive URLs, no external links to private content. Enforced by pattern: any value containing '/', ':', or a backslash is rejected at validation time, so directory paths and Drive/Groups/Sheets URLs cannot validate.

sha256.description: Optional content hash; include only when the underlying content is itself repo-safe (committed fixture or fictional example).

summary.description: One-sentence plain-language description of what this material is. Generic enough to publish in a public issue comment.

preview_rows.description: The pending-publish rows the organizer reviews. Each row is one proposed item that a separate, documented next step would create if approved. Rendering rows performs nothing.

privacy_review.description: Privacy review status of this summary. 'reviewer_role' is a generic role label — never a person name. 'status' captures whether the rows were reviewed and whether redactions were applied before display. 'not-reviewed' is permitted but should be uncommon; downstream consumers may treat it as a red flag.

non_claims.description: Required free-text array enumerating the standing non-claims this summary preserves. At minimum: not a mutation, not production deployment, not formal pilot authorization, not private-data handling. Producers may add summary-specific non-claims; producers MUST NOT remove the standing four.

id.description: Stable, locally-unique identifier for the row. Producers choose the format; consumers treat it as opaque. Must not encode private data (no emails, phones, sponsor names, or DIDs of unconsented participants).

kind.description: Closed taxonomy of pending-publish row kinds. Economic-adjacent kinds use regulatory-safe vocabulary only: 'obligation', 'allocation', and 'settlement' describe internal cooperative coordination primitives, never money transmission or stored value. 'action_item' = a proposed task. 'decision' = a proposed governance decision/proposal. 'attendance' = a proposed attendance/participation record. 'evidence_note' = a proposed evidence/provenance note. 'risk_note' = a flagged risk for the reviewer's attention.

plain_summary.description: One- or two-sentence plain-language summary of the row. The organizer should be able to understand what they would be approving from this summary alone. No private data; regulatory-safe vocabulary for economic-adjacent rows.

status.description: Closed taxonomy of per-row review status. 'pending_review' = awaiting an organizer decision. 'approved_for_publish' = organizer approved the row for the next documented step. **'approved_for_publish' is not production deployment, not pilot authorization, and not a mutation** — it only records that a human review boundary was crossed for this row. 'rejected' = organizer declined; the row must not proceed. 'needs_edit' = organizer wants changes before approval. 'needs_more_info' = organizer wants more context before deciding.

target_scope_label.description: Generic human-readable label for what the row targets (e.g. 'Example Working Group — next organizing cycle'). A label for rendering, not a DID and not a private identifier.

governing_body_label.description: Generic human-readable label for the governing body whose authority the row sits under (e.g. 'Example Stewards Circle'). A label for rendering, never a DID or private roster.

assignee_label.description: Optional generic role/holder label for who would be assigned (e.g. 'Example steward'). A label only — never a DID, email, or real name. Holder-label to DID binding is a separate documented step under the private-overlay / DID activation flow (icn#1730).

source_provenance_ref.description: Where this row was derived from, as a category plus a safe reference label — never a raw external path or private URL. The optional 'contract_urn' links the provenance to a related public contract when applicable.

category.description: Closed taxonomy of provenance categories. 'committed_fixture' = a file in the repository. 'meeting_record' = a meeting note/record. 'governance_record' = staged governance state. 'example_snippet' = inline fictional content. 'repo_safe_paste' = content confirmed repo-safe before pasting. 'prior_evidence_packet' = a previously exported repo-safe evidence packet.

ref_label.description: Safe basename or opaque reference label for the provenance source. No directory paths, no Drive/Groups/Sheets URLs, no private links. Enforced by pattern: any value containing '/', ':', or a backslash is rejected at validation time.

contract_urn.description: Optional non-DNS URN for a related contract (e.g. urn:icn:contract:rehearsal-evidence-export:v1).

authority_basis.description: Why the actor would have the right to act on this row, in plain language. Examples: 'domain_membership', 'meeting_attendee', 'assigned_action_item'. Mirrors the action-card authority_basis axis.

risk_level.description: Coarse risk indicator surfaced to the organizer. UI may sort or annotate but must not hide rows. Mirrors the action-card risk axis; exact semantics are a policy concern.

accessibility_hint.description: Plain-language accessibility note for the rendering shell. Per ADR-0028 discipline (mirrored from action cards), every row must carry one. Generic across institutions.

review_actions.description: The set of review affordances the organizer may take on this row. These are possible choices, NOT commands and NOT a record of actions taken — rendering them performs nothing. 'approve' = approve the row for the next documented step. 'reject' = decline the row. 'edit' = request changes before approval. 'request_info' = ask for more context before deciding. 'defer' = postpone a decision on this row to a later review pass.

mutation_preview.description: A read-only DESCRIPTION of what a separate, named, documented endpoint would create later if this row were approved. It is not a mutation, not an executable command, and carries no free-form payload (additionalProperties: false). The contract never performs the described creation.

would_create.description: Closed taxonomy of what would be created if approved. Economic-adjacent record kinds use regulatory-safe vocabulary only ('obligation_record', 'allocation_record', 'settlement_record' describe internal cooperative coordination primitives, never money transmission or stored value).

summary.description: One- or two-sentence plain-language description of what would be created and by which generic next step. No executable payload, no private data.

receipt_expected.description: Describes the receipt/evidence CATEGORY expected if the row's next step were taken. Never live receipt data. 'expected: false' with 'category: none' means no receipt is expected.

expected.description: Whether a receipt is expected at all if the row's next step were taken.

category.description: Closed taxonomy of expected receipt categories. 'none' when no receipt is expected.

privacy_notes.description: Optional plain-language privacy note for this row (e.g. 'No attendee roll is present; only a generic count is summarized.'). Generic phrasing; no private fields. Consumers must not treat this field as machine-actionable.
